/* ---------------------------------- helpers ---------------------------------- */
const fmt = (n) => Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US").replace(/,/g, " ") + " so'm";

/* ---------------------------------- atoms ---------------------------------- */
function Logo({ size = 34, ring = true }) {
  return (
    <div
      className="shrink-0 overflow-hidden"
      style={{
        width: size, height: size, borderRadius: "50%",
        border: ring ? `2px solid ${C.gold}` : "none",
        boxShadow: ring ? "0 2px 10px -3px rgba(0,0,0,.6)" : "none",
      }}
    >
      <img src={LOGO} alt="Remax Jizzax logo" style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "cover", display: "block" }} />
    </div>
  );
}

function DeviceGlyph({ Icon }) {
  return (
    <div
      className="relative flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"
      style={{
        width: 52, height: 52, borderRadius: 14,
        background: `linear-gradient(150deg, ${C.surface2}, ${C.surface})`,
        border: `1px solid ${C.border}`,
      }}
    >
      <Icon size={24} color={C.gold} strokeWidth={1.6} />
    </div>
  );
}

function ShineIntro({ loaded }) {
  return (
    <div className="relative inline-flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden" style={{ borderRadius: "50%" }}>
      <Logo size={84} />
      {loaded && (
        <div
          className="absolute inset-0"
          style={{
            borderRadius: "50%",
            background: "linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 30%, rgba(198,161,91,.6) 50%, transparent 70%)",
            animation: "shine 1.6s ease 300ms 1",
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------- App ---------------------------------- */
export default function App() {
  const [cart, setCart] = useState({});

  const [activeCat, setActiveCat] = useState("phones");

  const [loginOpen, setLoginOpen] = useState(false);
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loginForm, setLoginForm] = useState({ phone: "", password: "" });

  const [checkoutOpen, setCheckoutOpen] = useState(false);
  const [checkoutForm, setCheckoutForm] = useState({ name: "", phone: "", address: "", method: "delivery" });
  const [orderResult, setOrderResult] = useState(null);

  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [heroIndex, setHeroIndex] = useState(0);
  const catRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => { const t = setTimeout(() => setLoaded(true), 150); return () => clearTimeout(t); }, []);
  useEffect(() => { const t = setInterval(() => setHeroIndex((i) => (i + 1) % FEATURED.length), 3600); return () => clearInterval(t); }, []);
  useEffect(() => { if (!toast) return; const t = setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2200); return () => clearTimeout(t); }, [toast]);

  const cartItems = useMemo(
    () => Object.entries(cart).map(([id, qty]) => ({ ...PRODUCTS.find((p) => p.id === id), qty })).filter((x) => x.qty > 0),
    [cart]
  );
  const cartCount = cartItems.reduce((s, i) => s + i.qty, 0);
  const cartTotal = cartItems.reduce((s, i) => s + i.qty * i.price, 0);

  function addToCart(id) {
    setCart((c) => ({ ...c, [id]: (c[id] || 0) + 1 }));
    const p = PRODUCTS.find((x) => x.id === id);
    setToast(`${p.name} savatga qo'shildi`);
  }
  function changeQty(id, delta) {
    setCart((c) => ({ ...c, [id]: Math.max(0, (c[id] || 0) + delta) }));
  }

  function submitLogin(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!loginForm.phone) return;
    setUser({ phone: loginForm.phone });
    setLoginOpen(false);
    setToast("Xush kelibsiz!");
  }

  function submitCheckout(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!checkoutForm.name || !checkoutForm.phone) return;
    const orderId = "RJ-" + Math.floor(10000 + Math.random() * 89999);
    const text = buildOrderText(orderId);
    setOrderResult({ id: orderId, total: cartTotal, text });
    setCart({});
  }

  function buildOrderText(orderId) {
    const lines = cartItems.map((i) => `\u2022 ${i.name} x${i.qty} \u2014 ${fmt(i.price * i.qty)}`).join("\n");
    return `Yangi buyurtma ${orderId} (Remax Jizzax)\n${lines}\nJami: ${fmt(cartTotal)}\nIsm: ${checkoutForm.name}\nTelefon: ${checkoutForm.phone}\nManzil: ${checkoutForm.address || "-"}`;
  }
  function telegramLink() {
    const text = orderResult ? orderResult.text : buildOrderText("");
    return `https://t.me/remax50?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`;
  }

  const activeCategory = CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.id === activeCat);

        ::selection { background: ${C.blue}; color: white; }
        .chip { transition: transform 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; }
        .chip:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: ${C.gold}; }
        .catcard { transition: transform 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; }
        .catcard:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: ${C.gold}; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -14px rgba(198,161,91,.35); }
        .btn-primary { transition: transform 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; }
        .btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -10px rgba(198,161,91,.5); }
        .btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); }

        @keyframes spin360 { from { transform: rotate(0deg);} to { transform: rotate(360deg);} }
        @keyframes shine { from { transform: translateX(-120%); } to { transform: translateX(120%); } }
        @keyframes fadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
        @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
        @keyframes scaleIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.94); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
        @keyframes slideIn { from { transform: translateX(100%); } to { transform: translateX(0); } }
        @keyframes popIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.7) translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); } }
        @keyframes pulseGlow { 0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(198,161,91,.35);} 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(198,161,91,0);} }
        @keyframes floaty { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0);} 50% { transform: translateY(-8px);} }

              <Phone size={12} /> {PHONE}

                <span className="pop-in absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-semibold" style={{ width: 18, height: 18, borderRadius: 9, background: C.gold, color: "#0A0F0C" }}>
                  {cartCount}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => (user ? setUser(null) : setLoginOpen(true))} className="p-2 rounded-full" style={{ border: `1px solid ${C.border}`, background: user ? C.surface2 : "transparent" }} aria-label="Kirish">
              <User size={18} color={user ? C.gold : C.text} />

      </header>

      {/* ---------------- hero ---------------- */}
      <section className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-8 pt-14 pb-14 grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-10 items-center">
        <div className="fade-up">

          <h1 className="mt-6" style={{ fontFamily: DISPLAY, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "clamp(30px,5vw,48px)", lineHeight: 1.08 }}>

          </h1>
          <p className="mt-4 max-w-md" style={{ color: C.muted, fontSize: 16, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
            2015-yildan buyon telefon bozorida — original Remax aksessuarlari, smartfonlar va 1 yillik kafolat bilan xizmatingizdamiz.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

        </div>

        <div className="relative flex justify-center">
          <div className="floaty scale-in" style={{ width: 240, borderRadius: 32, padding: 18, background: `linear-gradient(160deg, ${C.surface2}, ${C.surface})`, border: `1px solid ${C.border}` }}>
            <div style={{ borderRadius: 22, background: C.bg, border: `1px solid ${C.borderSoft}`, padding: 18, minHeight: 250 }}>
              {FEATURED.map((p, i) => (
                <div key={p.id} style={{ display: i === heroIndex ? "block" : "none" }} className="fade-in">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                  </div>

        </div>
        <p className="max-w-6xl mx-auto mt-6 text-xs" style={{ color: C.muted }}>© {new Date().getFullYear()} Remax Jizzax. Barcha huquqlar himoyalangan.</p>
      </footer>

      {/* ---------------- toast ---------------- */}
      {toast && (
        <div className="scale-in fixed bottom-5 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-full text-sm flex items-center gap-2" style={{ background: C.surface2, border: `1px solid ${C.gold}`, boxShadow: "0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.5)" }}>
          <Check size={14} color={C.gold} /> {toast}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ---------------- cart drawer ---------------- */}
      {cartOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex justify-end">
          <div className="fade-in absolute inset-0" style={{ background: "rgba(0,0,0,.6)" }} onClick={() => setCartOpen(false)} />
          <div className="slide-in relative w-full sm:w-[400px] h-full flex flex-col" style={{ background: C.bg, borderLeft: `1px solid ${C.border}` }}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4" style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${C.borderSoft}` }}>
              <span style={{ fontFamily: DISPLAY, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 17 }}>Savat</span>
              <button onClick={() => setCartOpen(false)} className="p-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ border: `1px solid ${C.border}` }}><X size={16} /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-5 py-4">
              {cartItems.length === 0 && <p className="text-sm mt-6 text-center" style={{ color: C.muted }}>Savat bo'sh. Katalogdan mahsulot qo'shing.</p>}
              {cartItems.map((i) => (
                <div key={i.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 py-3" style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${C.borderSoft}` }}>
                  <DeviceGlyph Icon={CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.id === i.cat)?.Icon || Smartphone} />
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{i.name}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs mt-0.5" style={{ fontFamily: MONO, color: C.muted }}>{fmt(i.price)}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <button onClick={() => changeQty(i.id, -1)} className="p-1 rounded-full" style={{ border: `1px solid ${C.border}` }}><Minus size={12} /></button>
                    <span className="text-sm w-4 text-center">{i.qty}</span>
                    <button onClick={() => changeQty(i.id, 1)} className="p-1 rounded-full" style={{ border: `1px solid ${C.border}` }}><Plus size={12} /></button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {cartItems.length > 0 && (
              <div className="px-5 py-4" style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${C.borderSoft}` }}>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm mb-1">
                  <span style={{ color: C.muted }}>Jami</span>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: MONO, color: C.gold, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 600 }}>{fmt(cartTotal)}</span>
                </div>
                <button onClick={() => { setCartOpen(false); setCheckoutOpen(true); }} className="btn-primary w-full mt-3 py-3 rounded-xl font-medium" style={{ background: C.gold, color: "#0A0F0C" }}>
                  Buyurtma berish
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ---------------- login modal ---------------- */}
      {loginOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="fade-in absolute inset-0" style={{ background: "rgba(0,0,0,.65)" }} onClick={() => setLoginOpen(false)} />
          <form onSubmit={submitLogin} className="scale-in relative w-full max-w-sm p-6 rounded-2xl" style={{ background: C.surface, border: `1px solid ${C.border}` }}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Logo size={30} /><span style={{ fontFamily: DISPLAY, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 18 }}>Kirish</span></div>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setLoginOpen(false)} className="p-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ border: `1px solid ${C.border}` }}><X size={16} /></button>
            </div>
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 mb-3">
              <span className="text-xs" style={{ color: C.muted }}>Telefon raqam</span>
              <input required value={loginForm.phone} onChange={(e) => setLoginForm((f) => ({ ...f, phone: e.target.value }))} placeholder="+998 90 123 45 67"
                className="px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm" style={{ background: C.surface2, border: `1px solid ${C.border}`, color: C.text }} />
            </label>
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 mb-5">
              <span className="text-xs" style={{ color: C.muted }}>Parol</span>
              <input type="password" value={loginForm.password} onChange={(e) => setLoginForm((f) => ({ ...f, password: e.target.value }))}
                className="px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm" style={{ background: C.surface2, border: `1px solid ${C.border}`, color: C.text }} />
            </label>
            <button type="submit" className="btn-primary w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-medium" style={{ background: C.gold, color: "#0A0F0C" }}>Kirish</button>
            <p className="text-xs mt-3 text-center" style={{ color: C.muted }}>Bu — namoyish (demo) shakli, haqiqiy tizim uchun server kerak bo'ladi.</p>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ---------------- checkout modal ---------------- */}
      {checkoutOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="fade-in absolute inset-0" style={{ background: "rgba(0,0,0,.65)" }} onClick={() => { setCheckoutOpen(false); setOrderResult(null); }} />
          <div className="scale-in relative w-full max-w-md p-6 rounded-2xl max-h-[88vh] overflow-y-auto" style={{ background: C.surface, border: `1px solid ${C.border}` }}>
            {!orderResult ? (
              <form onSubmit={submitCheckout}>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: DISPLAY, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 18 }}>Buyurtmani rasmiylashtirish</span>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setCheckoutOpen(false)} className="p-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ border: `1px solid ${C.border}` }}><X size={16} /></button>
                </div>
                <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 mb-3">
                  <span className="text-xs" style={{ color: C.muted }}>Ismingiz</span>
                  <input required value={checkoutForm.name} onChange={(e) => setCheckoutForm((f) => ({ ...f, name: e.target.value }))}
                    className="px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm" style={{ background: C.surface2, border: `1px solid ${C.border}`, color: C.text }} />
                </label>
                <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 mb-3">
                  <span className="text-xs" style={{ color: C.muted }}>Telefon raqam</span>
                  <input required value={checkoutForm.phone} onChange={(e) => setCheckoutForm((f) => ({ ...f, phone: e.target.value }))} placeholder="+998 90 123 45 67"
                    className="px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm" style={{ background: C.surface2, border: `1px solid ${C.border}`, color: C.text }} />
                </label>
                <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 mb-4">
                  <span className="text-xs" style={{ color: C.muted }}>Manzil</span>
                  <input value={checkoutForm.address} onChange={(e) => setCheckoutForm((f) => ({ ...f, address: e.target.value }))} placeholder="Shahar, ko'cha, uy"
                    className="px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm" style={{ background: C.surface2, border: `1px solid ${C.border}`, color: C.text }} />
                </label>
                <div className="flex gap-2 mb-5">
                  {[["delivery", "Yetkazib berish"], ["pickup", "Olib ketish"]].map(([val, label]) => (
                    <button type="button" key={val} onClick={() => setCheckoutForm((f) => ({ ...f, method: val }))} className="flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs"
                      style={{ border: `1px solid ${checkoutForm.method === val ? C.gold : C.border}`, background: checkoutForm.method === val ? C.surface2 : "transparent" }}>
                      {label}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg" style={{ background: C.surface2 }}>
                  <span style={{ color: C.muted }}>Jami to'lov</span>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: MONO, color: C.gold, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 600 }}>{fmt(cartTotal)}</span>
                </div>
                <button type="submit" className="btn-primary w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-medium" style={{ background: C.gold, color: "#0A0F0C" }}>Buyurtmani tasdiqlash</button>
              </form>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-4 scale-in">
                <div className="glow-ring mx-auto flex items-center justify-center" style={{ width: 60, height: 60, borderRadius: 30, background: C.gold }}>
                  <Check size={28} color="#0A0F0C" />
                </div>
                <h3 className="mt-4" style={{ fontFamily: DISPLAY, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 19 }}>Buyurtma qabul qilindi!</h3>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm" style={{ color: C.muted }}>Buyurtma raqami: <span style={{ fontFamily: MONO, color: C.text }}>{orderResult.id}</span></p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm" style={{ color: C.muted }}>Summa: {fmt(orderResult.total)}</p>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2 mt-5">
                  <a href={telegramLink()} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="btn-primary inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-medium text-sm" style={{ background: C.gold, color: "#0A0F0C" }}>
                    <Send size={15} /> Telegram
                  </a>
                  <a href={INSTAGRAM_DM} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-medium text-sm" style={{ border: `1px solid ${C.border}` }}>
                    <Instagram size={15} color={C.gold} /> Instagram
                  </a>
                  <a href={PHONE_TEL} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-medium text-sm" style={{ border: `1px solid ${C.border}` }}>
                    <Phone size={15} color={C.gold} /> Qo'ng'iroq
                  </a>
                </div>
                <button onClick={() => { setCheckoutOpen(false); setOrderResult(null); }} className="block mx-auto mt-4 text-xs" style={{ color: C.muted }}>Yopish</button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
